resources.string: OpenFocus Shield checks which app is open so it can show a pause screen for apps you chose to block, and step out of Shorts/Reels feeds. It only looks at screen content inside the video apps you enabled in the Shield tab (to recognise their short-video feed), never reads what you type, and never records your screen. OpenFocus has no internet permission: nothing leaves your device. Note: some payment and banking apps limit payments while an accessibility service installed outside Google Play is on.
